title: [US TSP] Multi-login Matrix Console
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-04-22
html:
Product Overview

As a key enhancement to the Multilogin Matrix Console, the Multi-select shop to log in to Seller Center feature provides a streamlined entry point for batch store management. By allowing TSP to pre-select multiple authorized stores from a centralized pop-up, the system carries these selections into a single Seller Center session. This enables TSP to switch between seller backends instantaneously without re-navigating, delivering a high-efficiency, matrix-style workplace.

Product Benefits

The Multi-select shop to log in to Seller Center provides two primary advantages:

  • Eliminated Repetitive Manual Entry: By allowing loading multiple stores in a single action, the system replaces the tedious one-by-one access with efficient batch processing. This removes repetitive back-and-forth navigation and cuts down on redundant login time.
  • Efficient Multi-Store Switching: Seamless batch access replaces the need for back-and-forth navigation between stores. By removing the need for individual logins and fragmented steps, the Multi-select shop to log in to Seller Center tool streamlines high-volume store management and saves massive operational time.

User Guide

Step Process Screenshot
1 Enter the Multi-select shop to log in to Seller Center

* Page entrance: Partner center - Manage services - Service orders - Multi-select shop to log in to Seller Center
* Click "Multi-select shop to log in to Seller Center" within the Partner Center to trigger a centralized selection pop-up.
* Page URL: https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/leads-pool?page=1&region=US&searchParam=lead_status%3D1%26seller_type%3D2&size=10
* You can still use Single shop to log in to Seller Center, but you will only be able to manage one shop at a time. Therefore, we recommend using the new portal.



New feature

Old feature
2 Select shops in partner center

* From your authorized list, select stores that you intend to manage in the current session.

3 Switch shop in seller center

* The system will automatically carry all selected store identities into the backend, allowing you to switch between different seller environments via the top navigation bar without redundant logins or re-navigation.
4 Exit seller management

* Simply click the Return to partner center button — no need to log out.
